note: OID composite direction score. Research/log only - never places orders. Edit weights/enabled flags, bump config_version, then re-score history with score_report.py --config.

news.note: OPTIONAL, OFF (added 2026-10-20 per Jeffrey; do not enable without his OK). c = clamp(net 60-min news sentiment / net_scale, -1, 1); headlines -2..+2 each (FinBERT ProsusAI/finbert, lexicon fallback), X posts x0.5. Test with score_report.py --config on a copy with enabled=true.

changes.note: v1.1-20261020 (Jeffrey OK 2026-10-20): LOGGING ONLY, score math unchanged. Fast pass re-scores every cadence_pt.change_refresh_s on live price/1m bars/flow; writes ~/oid-data/score/changes-YYYYMMDD.jsonl on every score change and episodes-YYYYMMDD.jsonl when a score ends (score_changes.py). scores-*.jsonl slots, latest.json badge and outcomes grading unchanged.
changes.buffer_note: COMPARISON-ONLY shadow: buffered_score moves only when raw clears the .5 cutoff by buffer_band; logged on change rows + episodes-buffered-*.jsonl. Raw score stays primary everywhere.

light.note: LIGHT direction score for the Sector watch names (score_wide.py, launchd com.oid.desk.score-wide). Research/log only. Copies this config and keeps only components_enabled on (same calculations, scales and weights as the core); combine() divides by the enabled weights only (1.00+0.75+0.75=2.50) so the score keeps the -3..+3 range. Add/drop inputs by editing components_enabled (optional per-input 'weights' / 'components' overrides), then bump config_version. Core settings and core files are never touched. WIDECP 2026-10-20: change/episode rows now also log the Sector watch C/P (15 s / 1 m, tick test), flow lean and wall room as CONTEXT; the light score itself is unchanged (trend, volume, market only).

wide_full.note: FULL direction score for the Sector watch names (score_wide.py with OID_SCORE_PROFILE=wide_full, launchd com.oid.desk.score-widefull). Research/log only. All six core inputs with the core weights and math. flow = 1-min aggressor C/P from optflow-wide.json, classified by TICK TEST (trades only: no OPRA quotes for wide contracts), its quality multiplied by components.flow.q_tick. flip/walls = FlashAlpha levels from fa-walls-wide.json, which are pulled on surge only (<=30/day); names without levels log flip/walls as missing and the score shrinks toward 0 exactly as it does for a core name without walls. Added 2026-10-20 (WIDECP).
